title: Quality Gate Branch Intent
description: Schema for .quality-gate/branch.json — per-branch declaration of how the branch relates to main. Required on any branch other than main.

mode.description: extend = branch extends main (ratchet against merge-base baseline); replace = branch replaces main's baseline (own snapshot becomes new floor on merge).

anchor_ref.description: Git ref this branch is anchored against. For extend mode this is the ref used to compute merge-base. For replace mode this records the ref the branch is replacing.

established_commit.description: HEAD commit at the time establish ran. Metadata only — not verified at run.
